# Rounding 1 of 8

One run, 1 of 8 test cases passed (the rest fail), gate 90 (default). Rounding focus: the exact pass rate is 12.5%; the gate display rounds it down, the V&V view (vvRun.vvPassRate) rounds half up, and the verdict compares exact integers.

**Expected:** exit 0.

Arguments and expected values are in `case.json`; see the index `../README.md`.
